principles.p1_body: Keep enough density for quick scanning of status, metrics, failures, and next actions.
principles.p2_body: Expose metadata that helps repeat searches, evaluations, and worker runs under the same conditions.
principles.p3_body: Explain excluded information with aggregate counts only, without hidden titles or previews.
